title: JMAP shows nothing of a contact's reachability
description:
Person.clients (bead mimid-1wgh.140.5, decision mimid-1wgh.146) is the count the IRC front end reports as MONITOR's 730 and 731. It is a neutral record field, but mimid-agent-jmap's render.rs builds a ChatContact field by field and does not render it, so no JMAP client sees it.

That is the safe default -- nothing leaks by accident -- but it leaves the field's justification half true: it is in the shared store so both front ends could read it, and today only one does. Decide whether a JMAP client should see reachability at all, and if so under which draft-atwood-jmap-chat property; if not, say so at the field and close this. Mark's call: it is what a user sees.
